sections.Profile:
The Princess Bride is a pinball game based on the 1987 film of the same name. The story is widely considered one of the best stories ever told, and this game immerses you into that story. Most of the major scenes in the film are presented as individual modes you can play through, and each mode has unique rules that further connect you to the story.
